svg.title: How to read a waterfall display under a spectrum
svg.desc: A live spectrum above a waterfall display that shares its frequency axis. In the waterfall, time runs down with the newest row at the top and colour shows power. A steady carrier draws a straight vertical line; an FM signal draws a band whose width changes; a wideband digital channel draws a wide block; a burst transmitter draws short dashes at one frequency with gaps between; a frequency hopper draws short dots that jump between channels. The spectrum at the top shows only the present moment, when the burst transmitter is silent, so it does not appear there at all.
svg.text: Waterfall: the same frequency axis, time running down
and the hopper is on one channel.
